title: Audit Logging and Regulated Release Evidence Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies audit logging and regulated release evidence?
options: Create authoritative bounded events at trusted boundaries and bind reproducible release evidence to exact artifacts, controls, reviewers, and decisions.
questions.answer: Create authoritative bounded events at trusted boundaries and bind reproducible release evidence to exact artifacts, controls, reviewers, and decisions.
questions.explanation: The correct response preserves authority, compatibility, exact artifact evidence, adverse-path behavior, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Making an audit log append-only guarantees every recorded action is accurate and authorized.
questions.explanation: Writing audit records only from the Android client lets a modified or offline client omit, forge, reorder, or replay authoritative actions.

questions.answer: It is bound to exact source, configuration, artifact, tools, tests, reviewers, outcomes, and retained raw records.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the contract or mechanism that remains valid beyond one implementation demonstration.
